Automated translation (refer to source for accuracy)

The Hanno Children's Library will be temporarily closed for facility repairs during the following dates.

We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding and cooperation.

【Closure Period (All Day)】

December 4, 2025 (Reiwa 8) through January 15, 2026 (Reiwa 9)

【What to Know During the Closure】

• Reading at the Children's Library, borrowing books, and returning books will not be available.

• If you have reserved materials for pickup at the Children's Library, please pick them up at Hanno City Library (the main library) instead.

• The book drop box will remain available during the closure period.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-lib.jp/calendar/post-85.html
summary: 📚 Hanno Children's Library Temporary Closure (December 4, 2025 – January 15, 2026)
